readings: Find patients in the Patient table who have at least one Laboratory record where both `U-PRO` and `RA` are '-'. For each qualifying patient, show their ID and sex, plus the unrounded averages of `ALP` and `HCT` across all their Laboratory records, ignoring missing values. Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` descending with missing averages last, and show the top 10.

Find patients in the Patient table who have at least one Laboratory record where `U-PRO` is '-' and at least one Laboratory record where `RA` is '-'; these may be different records. For each qualifying patient, show their ID and sex, plus the unrounded averages of `ALP` and `HCT` across all their Laboratory records, ignoring missing values. Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` descending with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
queries:
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP,
    AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS q
    WHERE q.ID = p.ID
      AND q.`U-PRO` = '-'
      AND q.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID AND u.`U-PRO` = '-'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS r
    WHERE r.ID = p.ID AND r.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
